text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does vouch for their accuracy.
- Car bomb explosion kills five and wounds 18 in Blida.
- Suspected assassin of six children was shot dead in Baraki, near Algiers.
- Secular opposition leader Said Saadi says the terrorism suits the government which can pass all arbitrary decisions through the country in a climate of terror.
- Residents in remote southern regions and members of the armed and security forces to vote in referendum on Monday, three days before the national day of voting on a draft constitution.
- It seems that the people are completely convinced on the necessity to change the constitution.
- Algerian Energy Committe to discuss energy prospects in Algeria this week.
